mapper.select: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(s.target_year_month, 1, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS year, CAST(SUBSTRING(s.target_year_month, 5, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS month, s.target_contract_count AS targetCount, COUNT(c.id) AS contractCount, case when s.target_contract_count IS NULL OR s.target_contract_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(count(c.contract_result_code) / s.target_contract_count * 100, 1) END AS achievementRate FROM sales_monthly_target s LEFT JOIN contract c ON s.sales_user_id = c.sales_user_id AND c.contract_result_code = '02' WHERE s.sales_user_id = #{id} AND s.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} GROUP BY s.target_year_month, s.target_contract_count;
